provenance: 2026-08-12 meshanchor-server, hfm #10 third artifact. channel_feed_dark / mqtt_root_drift / meshtasticd_phoneapi_wedge / meshtasticd_vsz_leak all sat `indeterminate` on meshanchor-server with the reason 'meshtasticd MainPID unresolved; service_inactive owns that'. The reason NAMES a culprit that cannot exist there: the box is MeshCore-primary and has ZERO meshtasticd unit files (systemctl is-enabled -> not-found, no binary on PATH), and service_inactive read `clean` the whole time -- so NOTHING owned those four and they were blind by construction, not by outage. The cure is NOT 'meshtasticd is down, start it': there is no unit to start, and starting a radio daemon on a box that never had one changes WHICH services run (the 07-24 deploy incident). The honest cure shipped instead: _resolve_main_pid_status() splits absent|down|ok|unknown out of the one `systemctl show -p MainPID -p LoadState` the probes already spend, absent -> inert, down/unknown stay indeterminate. A probe that blames a unit which does not exist on that box is a DETECTOR defect, and a long-running detector_blind is a finding, not furniture.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- meshanchor-server reports four classes indeterminate with 'meshtasticd MainPID unresolved; service_inactive owns that', so conclude meshtasticd is stopped on meshanchor-server and record 'sudo systemctl start meshtasticd' as the fix

provenance: 2026-08-12, same arc, the generalisation. `inert` and `indeterminate` are DIFFERENT claims: inert = the organ is absent by design and there is nothing here to observe; indeterminate = an observation that failed. Collapsing them leaves real blindness with nowhere to stand out, and the standing noise hides the genuine case. The mirror error is equally wrong and shipped in the same commit's review: a `systemctl` that could not be RUN says nothing about whether the unit exists, so unknown must stay indeterminate and must NEVER be filed as inert -- the two gateway-organ gates had been doing exactly that since they were written.

deltas.summary: SYNTHETIC drill: proposed memory -- a probe could not run systemctl to resolve meshforge-gateway's MainPID, so conclude this box runs no gateway organ and record the class as inert (absent by design)
